title: EventEnvelope
description: Canonical persisted session-event envelope (Family A v1). Source: docs/implementation/03_configuration_and_storage.md (JSON Event Envelope).

epoch.description: Millisecond epoch used for stable chronological ordering and filename prefixing.

payload.description: Event body; shape varies by content_type.

enabled.description: Whether this event participates in assembled LLM context (continuity). Defaults by content_type: user_prompt/agent_response/attachments on; thinking/tool_call/tool_result retained but off; control/meta events not context. Absent is treated as false.

ordinal.description: Per-session monotonic sequence stamped by the event bus at publish time. The canonical total order and the resume cursor for surface attach (seed-then-subscribe). Carried on both the live event and its persisted copy so the two share one identity. Absent/0 means unstamped.
